record.name: Uber Headquarters at 1515 3rd St
search_aliases: 1515 3rd St, one of the two buildings of Uber's Mission Bay headquarters campus (1455 and 1515 3rd St)
record.summary: The six-story building at 1515 Third Street, the second building of the Uber headquarters campus designed by SHoP Architects (per ArchDaily) and developed by a joint venture of Alexandria Real Estate Equities and Uber formed in September 2014; the Assessor roll gives 6 stories, 302,084 sq ft and 2021 as year built, the Department of Building Inspection shows its new-construction permit completed on 2021-04-01, and OpenAI was reported in October 2023 to be leasing it, with 1455 Third Street, from Uber.

facts.value: Joint venture of Alexandria Real Estate Equities (51% interest, unconfirmed) and Uber Technologies, formed September 2014
SHoP Architects (ArchDaily lists the project year as 2022)
6 on the Assessor roll and in ArchDaily ('a six-story structure at 1515 Third Street'); the permit proposed 7 stories
302,084 (Assessor roll property_area); 422,980 rentable sq ft for 1455 and 1515 Third Street together (Alexandria, 2014)
$125.0 million purchase price for both parcels (1455/1515 Third Street) including 423 parking structure spaces, foundation piles, plans and permits; not split by building
OpenAI (lease reported October 2023, not a move-in date); whether Uber still occupies the building is unsettled

changes.text: Earlier entries said Uber is 'now shown as no longer at 1515' 3rd St. That is an inference, not something a source states. Uber's FY2025 annual report gives its principal executive offices as 1725 3rd Street and says Uber owns 'two adjacent office buildings, Mission Bay 1 & 2', without naming 1515 or saying Uber left it. The Real Deal (October 29, 2023) reported that Uber leased two of the four buildings of its Mission Bay headquarters to OpenAI and 'will continue to occupy the remaining buildings on its campus'. DataSF business registrations still list an Uber Technologies registration at 1515 3rd St with no end date. Whether Uber has left 1515 is not confirmed.

open_questions: Whether Uber still occupies 1515 3rd St is not settled by any source read. Uber's FY2025 annual report (Form 10-K, fiscal year ended December 31, 2025) gives its principal executive offices as '1725 3rd Street, San Francisco, California 94158' and says in Note 6 (Leases): 'We own two adjacent office buildings, Mission Bay 1 & 2'; it does not name 1515 3rd St or say that Uber left it. The Real Deal (2023-10-29) reported that Uber 'has leased two of the four buildings of its Mission Bay headquarters' to OpenAI and 'will continue to occupy the remaining buildings on its campus'. DataSF Registered Business Locations (read 2026-10-12) still lists 'Uber Technologies Inc' at 1515 3rd St with a location start date of 2020-06-25 and no end date, while a registration for Portier LLC (owner Uber Technologies, Inc.) at 1515 3rd St ends 2023-12-31. These are a 2023 lease report, a headquarters address and business registrations; none is a source written after an Uber move-out, so the tenant list's 'closed' for Uber at 1515 is an inference that has not been confirmed.
Uber's FY2022 annual report, which the changelog says gave 1515 3rd Street as its principal executive offices, could not be read (the SEC's site refused access) and is not relied on here.

OpenAI's occupancy of 1515 3rd St is not dated, and the tenant list's 'announced' is a 2023 expected state: the San Francisco Standard (2023-10-27) says OpenAI is leasing the two buildings and 'will be taking over' the space. Later reports speak of OpenAI's footprint without naming a building as occupied: the San Francisco Standard (2026-02-26) says OpenAI 'now occupies more than 1 million square feet in San Francisco’s Mission Bay neighborhood'; Hoodline (2026-01-09) says the company 'controls about 486,600 square feet through a sublease it picked up from Uber at 1455 and 1515 Third Street'; The Real Deal (2026-03-16) says OpenAI 'in recent years has subleased two buildings from Uber at 1455 and 1515 Third Street'. The DataSF registration for OpenAI at 1515 3rd St (location start 2024-12-09) is a registration date, not an opening date.

No source read gives a groundbreaking date or an opening or move-in month; the Department of Building Inspection completed date (2021-04-01) is a permit closeout date, the Assessor gives 2021 as year built and ArchDaily lists the project year as 2022.
The permit proposed 7 stories while the Assessor roll and ArchDaily give 6; not reconciled.

Developer of 1515 3rd St: the joint venture terms come from Alexandria's 3Q14 report, which is cited as saying 49% of the $125.0 million purchase price was funded by Uber; an ownership share for Uber is not stated. The report itself could not be read on the SEC's site, so these quotations are unconfirmed.

record.notes: Uber Headquarters at 1515 3rd St -- one of the two buildings of Uber's Mission Bay headquarters campus (1455 and 1515 3rd St), a 6-story, 302,084 sq ft office building (DataSF Assessor tax roll figures; year built 2021 per the Assessor, 2022 per ArchDaily's project page), designed by SHoP Architects and developed in a partnership between Uber and Alexandria Real Estate Equities (SocketSite, Sept 2016; ArchDaily names SHoP). Reported in October 2023 to be subleased to OpenAI along with 1455 3rd St (The Real Deal, SF Standard). Uber's FY2025 annual report (10-K) gives its principal executive offices as 1725 3rd St, not 1515.
